title: Introduce circuit lifecycle harmonizer and rollbackable hotpatch
author: Maya Patel
release_notes: Fix: stabilize rapid circuit flips by introducing a lifecycle harmonizer and safer rollback; includes telemetry for diagnosing misattributed evictions.
description:
Summary: This PR introduces a small, focused hotpatch that centralizes circuit state transitions into a 'circuit lifecycle harmonizer' to reduce flapping across regional routers and to make rollbacks safe and well-instrumented. The change is intentionally scoped to the serving path and the KV-drain coordination plumbing so we can ship a mitigation for an incident we observed on 2026-02-10 where multiple regions briefly oscillated into slowpath due to competing reopen timers.

Motivation: We observed repeated rapid circuit open/reopen sequences when (a) staggered KV-drain events raced with probe-driven reopen, and (b) temporary high-latency probes triggered per-tenant downgrade heuristics. That behavior amplified load shedding and caused higher than expected soft-degradation rates for a small subset of tenants. The harmonizer introduces an explicit epoched lifecycle per circuit with three goals: (1) avoid rapid reopen/open flips by applying a short jittered grace window, (2) ensure a single authoritative drain/reopen decision across the region for a tenant route, and (3) emit high-cardinality telemetry for postmortem and rollback decisions.

What changed: - Add pkg/shedder/circuit_lifecycle.go: a compact state machine that sequences open->draining->closed transitions with epoch anchors and jittered timers. - Add pkg/telemetry/circuit_events.go: structured events (JSON) emitted for open/drain/reopen decisions and reason codes. - Modify internal/allocator/kv_drain.go: elect a coordinator for KV-drain epochs and consult the harmonizer before claiming drain ownership. - Introduce a small rollout-toggle in charts/redwood/templates/circuit-config.yaml to gate the harmonizer per-cluster. - Tests: tests/stability/circuit_lifecycle_test.go covers timing behavior (deterministic timers via test clock). - docs: deploy/hotpatch/README.md documents the rollback path and emergency toggle.

Commit summary: - 3e9b4f2: initial harmonizer implementation and tests - f1a2c3d: wire telemetry events and reason codes - 7b8e9f0: KV-drain coordinator hook and gating flag - 0a1b2c3: docs + chart toggle + defensive checks for nil coordinator

Testing: - Unit tests added for state transitions and timer jitter (CI). - Integration load run on staging with a 5k-tenant synthetic spike showing a 43% reduction in reopen cycles vs baseline. - Canary rollout plan executed in us-west-2 with the chart toggle enabled for <1% of capacity initially; telemetry was monitored for two hours. - One flaky integration test failed on first CI run (stability/test_runner) due to test clock mis-sync; re-run passed and is included below.

Rollout & rollback: - Rollout method: gradual chart toggle (canary -> 10% -> 50% -> 100%) with 30m observation windows per step. - Abort criteria: increase in soft-degrades > 2x baseline or >1.5x reopen rate. - Immediate rollback: flip chart toggle to disabled and restart sidecar; harmonizer is stateless (epoch metadata kept in existing KV) so rollback restores previous behavior without data loss. - Emergency patch: deploy hotfix branch with harmonizer disabled but telemetry still emitted (this was used in staging validation).

Follow-ups: - Propagate harmonizer events into Console SLO dashboard (ENG-2197). - Consider merging epoch election into allocator leader module to reduce cross-component calls (refactor ticket ENG-2203).

Notes: This PR intentionally avoids changing tenant prioritization logic or global SLO thresholds. The goal is to stabilize circuit lifecycles and provide better observability to make subsequent SLO tuning safer.

review_comments: Liam O'Connor: Nice focused scope. Two asks: (1) can we make the grace window configurable per-cluster (not just chart-level)? (2) add a low-sample-rate dump to help postmortem tenant-level traces.
Author (Maya Patel): Addressed both — added chart toggle and cluster override in router_proxy.go, and added a 0.1% sample dump for tenant traces behind the same toggle.

Ethan Chen: Unit tests look good; integration run shows improvement. One nit: reason code strings should be enumerated in telemetry to avoid drifting labels. Please add a small enum in circuit_events.go.
Author (Maya Patel): Added telemetry enum and updated tests to assert enum values rather than free strings.
Sofia Martinez: CI flaky test observed on first run. Confirmed re-run fixed. Please note in changelog that test harness depends on test clock alignment. Approved after re-run.
Infra Bot: Lint passed; go vet flagged a nil-check that was fixed in 0a1b2c3 commit. All green now.
